tools.description:
Execute an async QuickJS cell: {code, environment?, maxOutputTokens?}. main is automatic. Locals are fresh each cell; state persists while its environment lives. This is not Node; use tools.exec for installed programs. Await host calls.
A single expression returns its value; multi-statement cells use explicit return. The entire reply (result, receipts and state notices) defaults to 10,000 estimated O200kBase tokens; maxOutputTokens is an integer >=256. A 60 KiB UTF-8 reply backstop still applies. Large successful results return a marked head/tail text preview with fullOutput.path: a generated workspace-local .run/js-output file readable using tools.read or tools.exec. Save full values in state for later JS processing; preview limits do not reset the heap. Spill failures are explicit and preserve successful state. Underlying serialized returns have a 1 MiB resource ceiling; unsupported/cyclic values fail explicitly. Undefined/no return gives an execution receipt.
state.reset() clears saved data in-cell, keeping the heap and operations alive. Net state changes append key-only notices after [---]; nested edits mark their top-level key. Observation is bounded and reports incomplete coverage.
text(markdown) publishes to the user; returning data does not. await file({path,name?}) or image({path,name?,alt?}) captures a workspace-relative file as an immutable artifact.
Host tools: tools.<name>(args). tools.$search(query, {limit?}) returns up to limit (default 5) matching tool definitions {name,description,inputSchema}; query "select:a,b" returns exactly those. tools.$list() returns [{name,summary,shownAlways}].
tools.web_fetch({id?, max_chars?, offset?, query?, top_k?, url?}) -> JSON: Read a URL or saved source id as Markdown/text. Returns {id?,source?:{id,url,title,backend},url,backend,title,content,total_chars,passages:[{number,text,start_offset,end_offset}],next_offset?}. source is the original saved mapping; url is the final fetched URL. Passages have stable page-local numbers; cite source ID and passage number. Optional query retrieves top_k passages using local BM25. Otherwise offsets page Unicode characters; follow next_offset. Cached reads use no request budget.
tools.web_search({count?, query}) -> JSON: Search the web. Returns {backend,results:[{id?,title,url,snippet}]}. Store-aware hosts persist short source IDs (s1, s2, ...) shared with this chat's children. Search snippets are leads; fetch sources before citing them.
Other tools (callable now; get their schemas with tools.$search): environments
One active cell per environment; a waiting cell can return background status before its eventual value is available. Failed/cancelled cells replace state and increment generation. Limits: 4 environments/session, 16 total, 32 MiB heap, 3 seconds active JS, 30 seconds non-wait idle. No filesystem/network globals; use the listed host calls.
